name: Cape Adare, Camp Ridley
locator: Chapters IV and VIII, pp. 100–124 and 250–253; New Zealand Herald, 27 October 1900, p. 13, address reporting ten left to overwinter; Antarctic Heritage Trust expedition history reporting Hanson's 14 October death.
definition: Members of the Southern Cross shore party assigned to Camp Ridley on the opening date. Their exact physical attendance at midnight is unknown. Temporary expedition presence. Other Antarctic or polar visitors and permanent residence are outside this observation.
method: Subtract one known death in October 1899 from the initial ten left to overwinter. The ship returned after 1 January 1900.
